about.title: About Me
about.description: A Software Engineer with a growing focus on RF systems, satellite communication, GIS, remote sensing, and space technology. I'm interested in building intelligent engineering systems that connect software, AI, data, and real-world technical operations.
about.metaCertDescription: Earned through Meta's rigorous program via Coursera, this certification validates proficiency in front-end development, including React, JavaScript, UI design principles, debugging, version control with Git, and deploying production-ready applications.
about.academicCollaboration: Open to academic collaboration, AI/ML research, RF systems, satellite communication, GIS, remote sensing, and engineering software projects.
about.techStackDescription: Proficient in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript, and frameworks like React, Next.js, Node.js, and React Native. Skilled in database management (MongoDB, PostgreSQL), AI API integrations, LLM workflows, and cloud deployment. Experienced with scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, Tailwind CSS, Docker, Prisma, Redux, Flutter, QGIS, ESA SNAP, Google Earth Engine, GDAL, Rasterio, GeoPandas, Leaflet, and scalable backend architecture.

limelight.title: Software Engineer
contents: Working on the full-stack development of an in-house ERP platform for fashion retail and manufacturing, covering product lifecycle management, manufacturing execution, finance, retail, inventory, and broader business operations.

suparco.title: Computer Science Intern
contents: Collaborated with satellite-control and carrier-operations teams, gaining practical experience in carrier monitoring, service-availability checks, interference observation, and ground-station workflows.

Supported activities involving PAKSAT-1R and PAKSAT-MM1 communication services, including C-, Ku-, and Ka-band RF systems, VSAT and antenna operations, HTS network management, and software tools for satellite-communications monitoring and data analysis.
Contributed to the development of in-house engineering software for operational monitoring, workflow automation, data management, and visualization.

vixelsEngineer.title: Software Engineer
contents: Delivered production web, mobile, AI-enabled, and headless Shopify applications using React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.

Owned features from system design through deployment using AWS, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines, working with microservices, message queues, event-driven architecture, caching, and Shopify integrations through the Storefront API, GraphQL Admin API, webhooks, and Shopify Functions.

vixelsAssociate.title: Associate Software Engineer
contents: Built full-stack applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB, implementing REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication and authorization, database models, reusable components, and third-party integrations.

pepsico.title: Supply Chain Intern
contents: Completed a spares-mapping and criticality-analysis project using HFM, ABC, and XYZ methods, producing a three-year inventory projection and evaluating localization, unbadging, and alternative-vendor sourcing to strengthen maintenance-inventory planning.

bachelors.title: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
contents: Awarded 50% CGPA-based scholarship from October 2020 to July 2024.
Completed coursework in key subjects including Programming, Data Structures, Algorithms, Database Systems, Web Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Deep Learning.

intermediate.title: Intermediate in Computer Science (Physics)
contents: Specialized in Computer Science and Physics.

matriculation.title: Matriculation (Science)
contents: Won first place in an inter-section English writing competition in 8th grade.
Achieved victory in an inter-campus table tennis competition with my team.
